sintesis.es: El Senado estadounidense confirmó, tras una reñida votación, a Todd Blanche como nuevo fiscal general de Estados Unidos, pese a las críticas de la oposición, que lo acusan de convertir el Departamento de Justicia en una herramienta al servicio del presidente Trump.
sintesis.en: Todd Blanche, U.S. President Donald Trump's former personal lawyer, was sworn in on Monday as attorney general after narrowly winning Senate confirmation in a 50-49 vote. Blanche had been serving as acting attorney general since Trump fired Pam Bondi in April.

titulo.es: Irán condiciona la reapertura de Ormuz a que EE.UU. levante el bloqueo y las sanciones
titulo.en: Trump hid in catering cart to board secret flight in Turkey amid Iran threat – reports

sintesis.es: El portavoz de Exteriores de Irán replicó que "los iraníes han demostrado ser ajedrecistas profesionales" después de que Trump dijera que se lo tomaba con calma y comparara las negociaciones con Teherán con una partida de ajedrez.
sintesis.en: Elaborate ruse was used to transport president to military flight from Air Force One to return from Nato meet Prompted by an Iranian assassination threat, Donald Trump departed on a secret military flight from Turkey to Britain last month when the White House said he was flying aboard ⁠Air Force One, in an extraordinary ruse that involved hiding the president in an airport catering cart, according to reporting from the Washington Post and the New York Times. The operation took place when Trump was in Ankara for a Nato summit with world leaders, according to the Post . The president reportedly boarded the old Air Force One jumbo jet in view of television cameras, and then was secretly shuttled minutes later to a smaller plane via an airport catering truck typically used to load meals and other supplies preflight, a US official told the Post.

titulo.es: Centenares de vuelos cancelados por la tormenta tropical Dolphin en el este de China
titulo.en: Typhoon Dolphin: more than a million people evacuated in China as record rainfall dumped on Shanghai

sintesis.es: Más de 900 aviones, cerca del 40% de los previstos, se quedaron en tierra solamente en los aeropuertos de Hongqiao y Pudong de Shanghái, sumándose a unos 1.300 anulados el día anterior, según el operador de esta infraestructura.
sintesis.en: Authorities warn that days of intense rain could trigger widespread flooding and landslides as storm moves north and further inland More than a million people were moved to safety across eastern China by Sunday evening as powerful Typhoon Dolphin made landfall amid fears torrential rain would cause flooding and landslides. Wenzhou, a coastal city in Zhejiang province, said it relocated more than 900,000 people and opened more than 1,500 emergency shelters. In neighbouring Fujian, 98,900 people were moved from high-risk areas.

titulo.es: Terremoto de magnitud 7,4 en Colombia deja más de 130 muertos y cientos de heridos
titulo.en: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake in Colombia leaves more than 130 dead and hundreds injured

sintesis.es: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,4 con epicentro en San José del Palmar, Chocó, sacudió el occidente y centro de Colombia el 10 de agosto de 2026, afectando gravemente a Cali, Pereira, Manizales y Quibdó. El sismo dejó al menos 132 muertos, más de 500 heridos y numerosos desaparecidos, con decenas de estructuras colapsadas solo en Cali. El recién investido presidente Abelardo de la Espriella declaró el desastre nacional y viajó a las zonas afectadas mientras continúan las labores de rescate.
sintesis.en: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake centered in San José del Palmar, Chocó, struck western and central Colombia on August 10, 2026, severely affecting Cali, Pereira, Manizales and Quibdó. The quake killed at least 132 people, injured more than 500, and left many missing, with dozens of structures collapsed in Cali alone. Newly inaugurated President Abelardo de la Espriella declared a national disaster and traveled to affected areas as rescue operations continue.

titulo.es: Scores dead in Colombia after powerful earthquake strikes west of country
titulo.en: Scores dead in Colombia after powerful earthquake strikes west of country

sintesis.es: Quake of 7.4 magnitude collapses and severely damages buildings in several major cities, including Cali and Pereira More than 100 people died after a powerful earthquake struck western Colombia, collapsing and severely damaging scores of buildings in major cities including Cali and Pereira. The US and Colombian geological surveys reported that a 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck at 7.34am local time on Monday, with its epicentre in the western department of Chocó. It was felt in neighbouring Venezuela, still reeling from a deadly double earthquake on 24 June.

titulo.es: The sun will vanish over Europe in a rare total solar eclipse: Watch live
titulo.en: The sun will vanish over Europe in a rare total solar eclipse: Watch live

sintesis.es: A total solar eclipse will plunge parts of Europe into darkness on August 12, 2026, with Spain offering some of the best views. ESA will livestream the spectacle from the Javalambre Observatory, combining telescope feeds, drone footage, and expert commentary. At 20:31 CEST, the observatory will experience 1 minute and 21 seconds of totality, revealing the Sun’s normally hidden outer atmosphere.
